upsert.title: Artificial neobladder placement for dogs with resectable lower urinary tract tumors
upsert.status: Currently listed on AMC's current clinical trials index
upsert.funding: AMC does not state study-covered or owner-paid costs on the current study page; confirm costs with the study team.
upsert.notes: Interventional surgical treatment study for dogs with biopsy-documented transitional/urothelial carcinoma involving the bladder and/or urethra. The protocol evaluates removal of the distal ureters, urinary bladder and urethra followed by placement of an artificial silicone neobladder. A drainage catheter is used for manual urine drainage 2–3 times daily, so owner ability to perform repeated manual drainage is a key eligibility requirement. Full protocol eligibility and resectability require AMC prescreening.

upsert.title: Immunotherapy for Urothelial Carcinoma in Dogs
upsert.center: Veterinary Specialty Hospital - North County / Ethos network
upsert.contacts: VSH-North County — 760-466-0600; participating sites also include CASE in Boulder, CO and Metropolitan Veterinary Hospital - Cleveland East in Highland Heights, OH.
upsert.funding: Study treatment, physical exams, hospitalization, and study-required diagnostics are free of charge; up to $3,000 is available for treatment of suspected study-related side effects. Non-study costs are not covered.
upsert.notes: Open treatment study evaluating tolerability and efficacy of a novel immunotherapy in dogs with urothelial/transitional cell carcinoma. Participating hospitals: CASE, Boulder, CO; Metropolitan Veterinary Hospital - Cleveland East, Highland Heights, OH; and VSH-North County, San Marcos, CA. Final eligibility requires study-team prescreening.

upsert.title: Ethos Precision Medicine Umbrella Study for Hemangiosarcoma (ePUSH)
upsert.contacts: Ethos Discovery enrollment form / participating hospital; VSH-North County — 760-466-0600.
upsert.funding: Partially funded at surgery/prescreen stage; $1,000 toward surgery and up to $3,000 for treatment of study-related side effects. Dogs confirmed with hemangiosarcoma and no metastasis that continue to the treatment phase receive fully funded treatment at no cost to the client (> $10,000 stated value).
upsert.notes: Canonical ePUSH record. Open precision-medicine umbrella study for dogs presenting with a ruptured splenic tumor. Samples are collected at splenectomy; dogs subsequently confirmed to have hemangiosarcoma without metastasis may continue to a treatment phase using therapies matched to HSA genomic subtype. Multiple Ethos and non-Ethos US sites participate.

upsert.title: MIMIC — minimally invasive metastasectomy for osteosarcoma lung metastases
upsert.center: Ethos Discovery / Veterinary Specialty Hospital - North County
upsert.contacts: Ethos Discovery enrollment/request-information form; VSH-North County — 760-466-0600.
upsert.funding: Subsidized study; Ethos states all procedures are provided at an affordable, low cost. Exact owner cost is not published and should be confirmed with the study team.
upsert.notes: Canonical MIMIC record. Open minimally invasive pulmonary metastasectomy study using thoracoscopic surgery for dogs with osteosarcoma metastatic to the lungs. Primary Ethos page is used for current status and funding. Final eligibility requires study-team prescreening.

upsert.title: Novel oral rapamycin formulation dose/tolerability study for dogs with cancer
upsert.contacts: Ethos Discovery enrollment request through official study page; VSH-North County — 760-466-0600.
upsert.funding: All study-associated costs are covered, including exam fee, blood work, and medication (approximately $1,500 stated value); treatment of study-related side effects is covered up to $3,000.
upsert.notes: Canonical Ethos rapamycin record. Open pharmacokinetic/dose study of a novel oral rapamycin formulation in dogs recently diagnosed with a malignancy. It characterizes absorption and defines a dose for future efficacy trials; it is not itself an efficacy trial. Current listed sites include Peak Veterinary Referral Center, VSH-North County, VSH-Sorrento Valley, and WVRC-Waukesha.
